one_line: Western Kshaharata Saka ruler who controlled key ports and trade routes in 1st–2nd century CE western Deccan.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean but solidly built, with the posture of a hardened cavalry commander turned ruler.
appearance.face: Angular oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, sharp jawline and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; medium wheat-to-olive complexion hinting at northwestern Saka roots blended with Deccan sun; keen dark eyes with slightly furrowed brows; default expression is calm, calculating authority with a faint, composed half‑smile.
appearance.hair: Straight, dark brown‑black hair, medium length, combed back from the forehead and tied into a low knot at the back of the head; sides kept tidy; he wears a soft, rounded Saka‑style cloth cap in deep maroon, fitting close to the skull with a narrow tan band at the base.
appearance.costume: He wears a long‑sleeved, hip‑length, front‑wrapping tunic inspired by Saka/Indo‑Scythian and western Deccan dress, in rich deep green cotton with a subtle woven diagonal pattern and a V‑shaped overlap closing right over left, secured by a narrow dark brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle; over this he has a sleeveless quilted vest in muted maroon, lightly padded and edged with narrow cream piping, hinting at light armour but still cloth‑based; his lower garment is a straight, ankle‑length wrapped cloth in undyed off‑white cotton (like an early dhoti‑style lower wrap) pleated at the front and tucked securely into the belt, allowing free movement; he wears fitted dark brown leather boots reaching mid‑calf, with simple stitched seams and soft soles, practical for riding and walking uneven trade routes; around his shoulders is a broad woolen shawl in dusty blue, draped from the left shoulder across the chest and under the right arm, its ends hanging behind, with a thin geometric border in maroon and cream; jewellery is restrained but royal: a single medium‑width gold torque resting at the base of his neck, a pair of modest gold hoop earrings, and a simple signet ring on his right hand; overall the textiles are matte and practical, evoking a ruler who travels his routes rather than sitting only in a palace.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved, single‑edged Saka cavalry sword (akin to an early sabre) with a plain bronze cross‑guard, leather‑wrapped hilt and iron blade about forearm length, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard worn suspended from his belt at his left hip, which he often rests his hand upon while surveying routes or cave works.

ref_desc: Nahapana is a late‑30s lean Saka ruler with an angular bearded face, dark eyes, back‑tied dark hair under a maroon cap, wearing a deep green wrap tunic, maroon sleeveless vest, off‑white wrapped lower cloth, dusty blue shawl, dark brown boots and gold torque, carrying a curved Saka sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Nahapana, a late‑30s lean Saka ruler with an angular bearded face, dark eyes and straight dark brown‑black hair combed back into a low knot, wearing a close‑fitting maroon cloth cap with a tan band. Show his deep green long‑sleeved wrap tunic with a V overlap, cinched by a narrow dark brown leather belt with bronze buckle, and over it a sleeveless quilted maroon vest edged in cream. His lower garment is an ankle‑length off‑white wrapped cloth, pleated in front and tucked into the belt, paired with fitted dark brown mid‑calf leather boots. Drape a broad dusty blue woolen shawl with a thin maroon and cream geometric border from his left shoulder across his chest and under his right arm. Add subtle gold jewellery: a simple neck torque, small hoop earrings and a single signet ring on his right hand. At his left hip hang a slightly curved Saka cavalry sword in a dark brown leather scabbard, with a bronze cross‑guard and leather‑wrapped hilt, his hand often resting lightly on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by deep green, maroon, dusty blue, off‑white and dark brown, and present him front and three‑quarter views in a dignified, composed stance suitable for a historically grounded action anime.
